title: Notes on weathering cancer
content:
# Notes on weathering cancer

This is a personal account of navigating cancer diagnosis and treatment. These notes are written from my own experience and are not medical advice.

## The diagnosis

Receiving a cancer diagnosis is like being handed a map to a country you never wanted to visit. The landscape is unfamiliar, the language foreign, and the customs strange. Yet here you are, passport stamped, luggage packed with uncertainty.

# About

This is a personal blog about health, illness, and recovery. It contains reflections on navigating cancer diagnosis and treatment, written from personal experience.

## Purpose

These writings are meant to:
- Share personal experiences with health challenges
- Provide comfort to others facing similar situations
- Document the journey of recovery and healing
- Explore the intersection of illness and meaning
